newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy two car dealers for $75 mln.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy two car dealers for $75 mln.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Monday it has signed definitive agreements to buy two car dealerships for $75 million in common stock.

To be purchased are Kendall Toyota, which owns and operates Toyota, Lexus and Kia dealerships in Miami, Fla., and Joe Myers Automotive Group, which owns and operates Ford, Toyota, Mitsubishi, Mazda and Kia dealerships in Houston.
Kendall Toyota is being accounted for as a purchase and Joe Myers Automotive is being accounted for as a pooling of interests.
The transactions are subject to customary closing conditions, including appropriate manufacturer approvals.
Republic is a diversified company operating in the automotive, solid waste and electronic security industries.
